verdict.rationale: Jeeves offers one-click export/sync to NetSuite, QuickBooks, and Xero and exposes transaction data via API/webhooks, but there is no evidence of true real-time bidirectional sync (e.g., automated journal entry creation/reconciliation back into the ERP) — only export-style sync is documented. Missing for 10: bidirectional sync mechanics, automated journal-entry posting, reconciliation workflow, and independent confirmation the sync eliminates manual entries.
